At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

Design and develop modern architectures using NEXT.JS, AWS technologies, Microservices, NoSQL, and event-driven architectures.
Take ownership of solution architecture, improving performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
Drive feature development from inception to delivery, contributing to an ambitious product roadmap.
Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies.
Foster an open communication culture, encouraging feedback and supporting conflict resolution.


 Your Profile:

6+ years of experience in software development.
Proficiency in Next.js / Node.js, with experience building reusable libraries using an atomic design system.

Keen architectural mindset with an eye for application design patterns.
Excellent communication skills with fluency in English (written and spoken).

Experience working with AWS cloud.

Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.Strategic Use of Data for Staged TrainingA recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.4. Hardware & Systems UnderstandingEfficient Implementations at ScaleMany works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.Real-Time & On-Device ConstraintsSoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.Architectural & Optimization DetailsPapers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.5. Rigorous Experimental DesignControlled Comparisons & AblationsNearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.SummaryOverall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principlesA talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutionsThe capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversityAwareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiencyThorough and transparent experimental practicesThese qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). description_clean: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
 
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
 
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.Role overview
 
Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business.
 
Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact.
 
To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées.Commercial Growth
Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform.
Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution.
Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions.
Relationship Building
Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption.
Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications.
Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits.
Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.
Collaboration  - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.
Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.

 

This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role
Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities

title: Platform Security Engineer
description_clean:
At Scality, we build software that stores and protects the world’s most critical data — running on Linux, inside some of the largest infrastructures on the planet, at exabyte scale, for organizations that cannot afford to fail.
We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join our platform and delivery team in Paris. This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity.
This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role. You will not write policies for other people to implement — you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound.

About ScalityScality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors — exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox.
Industry recognition:

Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years — the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant’s inception
#1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage (2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors
Gold Stevie Award 2025 — ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage & Backup Solution category
Net Promoter Score of 85 across RING and ARTESCA
About the team
You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining ADI (Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform: RING (object storage), S3C (S3-compatible layer), and SCOS (Scality OS — our own Linux distribution).
The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering — deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers.
How We Build
We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day.
We are also designing something larger: an AI code and delivery factory — AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build.
If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it.
One principle is not negotiable: a human owns the outcome. AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces — the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. “The tool did it” is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all.
How This Role Works
Scality is building a network of security engineers across the engineering department — a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm’s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team.

Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering. The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone — and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is how we intend to change that. You would help build that capability, not inherit a finished one.
The team is accountable for the deliveries. Security items sit on the team’s plate alongside everything else it commits to, rather than in a separate function filing tickets from the outside.
You are the dedicated resource that makes them happen. While your teammates carry releases, OS compatibility, and platform features, your time is reserved for the security work. That focus is the whole reason the seat exists.
You share the team’s perimeter and its knowledge. Same repositories, same Jira projects, same code reviews, same sprint rituals. The engineers around you have rare, hard-earned Linux depth — OS integration, RPM packaging, boot and GRUB, CI/CD, monitoring — and you will learn the platform from them.
You will have peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams work the same problems on different perimeters. That network is where you compare notes, share tooling, and grow into the craft.

The point of the model is that security decisions get made inside the team that builds and ships the product, by someone who understands the build system rather than filing tickets against it.
Your First Missions
Two priorities are already on the roadmap, and they will shape your first year.
1. CVE exposure, answered before it is asked
Customers in banking, healthcare, and government ask us, routinely and under their own audit obligations, whether our products are exposed to a given CVE. That will not stop — for them, asking is the compliance requirement. Today each answer is researched from scratch: a customer question becomes a ticket, the ticket becomes a hunt through SBOMs, vendor advisories, and our own configuration, and the round trip can take weeks to produce something the team is not fully confident defending.
Your first mission is to invert that, so the answer already exists when the question arrives.

A standing exposure record, per shipped component and per release: what the SBOM says is present, what the upstream vendor has decided (including “will not fix”, which is common on RHEL 8 and often the real answer), and whether the vulnerable code path is actually reachable in our configuration
Reachability over presence. A module shipped and loaded by a distribution default is not the same as a module configured on a live URL. That distinction is the difference between “vulnerable” and “no impact”, and it is where the engineering judgement lives
Continuous CVE detection across our repositories, vendored third-party modules, container images, and shipped RPMs
Wiring detection into our existing SBOM tooling and GitHub Actions pipelines, so exposure is computed when a release is built rather than when a customer asks
A defined interface with the security engineers and the customer-facing teams: who produces the technical assessment, who owns the wording that reaches the customer, and how both meet the response commitments in our customer security policy
Durable capture. An assessment that lives only in a ticket comment gets re-derived next release. Findings belong somewhere queryable
A remediation loop with clear ownership and response targets, integrated with how the team already works in Jira
AI-assisted remediation, where it fits: from advisory to proposed patch to a tested build, with a human deciding what ships

Done well, a customer’s “are you affected by X?” becomes a lookup and an afternoon, not an escalation and three weeks.
2. Raising the security baseline of SCOS
SCOS is our own Linux distribution — we control the kickstarts, the package set, the boot path, and the images. That is unusual leverage, and we intend to use it. You will drive platform-level hardening across the OS we ship:

A hardened, defensible default configuration for the distribution
Advancing SELinux enforcement across RING and S3C (work already begun on the team, which you will help carry)
Supply-chain integrity: artifact provenance, signing, dependency currency, reproducible and verifiable builds
Secrets and credential handling across the delivery pipeline
Cryptographic posture — including FIPS 140-3 readiness, which matters concretely: FIPS 140-2 certificates move to NIST’s historical list on 22 September 2026, and RHEL 9’s validated OpenSSL, GnuTLS, and kernel crypto modules are the foundation we build on
Compliance-driven engineering work, notably the supply-chain security expectations of NIS2 (Article 21(2)(d)) and the EU Cyber Resilience Act — translated into automation and evidence, not spreadsheets

You will also contribute to what comes next: threat modelling of the platform, hardening guidance for customers, and security review of significant design changes.
What We Are Looking For
This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into being their team’s security reference. We expect to invest in you, and we expect you to keep growing here for as long as you want to — there is no ceiling built into this seat.
Required

Linux is your primary operating system — at work, at home, or both. You are comfortable in the terminal and you reach for a shell before a UI
Roughly 2–4 years of relevant experience, or a shorter track record with unusually strong evidence of the skills below
Solid working ability in Python and Bash — you will be writing and maintaining real code in a production codebase
A genuine, demonstrable interest in security. We care much more about this than about formal credentials. Show it however it is true for you: CTFs, a home lab, reading advisories and CVE writeups for fun, a hardening project, security-adjacent contributions, a blog, anything real
Comfortable using Git in a collaborative environment
Ability to read and understand existing code before modifying it
The judgement to tell a real risk from a scanner’s opinion — and the instinct to check whether vulnerable code is actually reachable before calling it exposed
The willingness to say plainly when you are not yet sure, rather than producing an answer you could not defend
French — the team works in French day to day
Written communication skills in English

Nice to Have

CVE triage, CVSS scoring, or vulnerability management experience
Reading vendor advisories and understanding vendor triage — NVD, RHSA, Red Hat severity and will-not-fix calls
Supply-chain security tooling — SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX), scanners (Trivy, Grype, Syft), artifact signing
RPM packaging or Linux distribution internals
SELinux policy work
CI/CD systems, especially GitHub Actions
RHEL / Rocky Linux (versions 8 and 9)
Containers (Docker, containerd, systemd units)
Ansible or Salt
Awareness of NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, or FIPS 140-3
Familiarity with S3 or object storage concepts
Serious use of AI coding tools in a real workflow — Claude Code or equivalent, beyond autocomplete

To Be Clear About Scope
This is a software engineering role with a security mandate. It is not a SOC or incident-response analyst position, not a penetration-testing role, and not a GRC or compliance-documentation role. If what you want is to build the tooling and harden the system yourself, in code, you are in the right place.
What We Offer

Dedicated focus. Security is your job here, not the thing you get to after the sprint work is done
Clear direction, and a say in it. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering, and the team is accountable for delivering them. You would not be inventing the agenda on your own, you would help shape what goes on it, and you would be part of making it stick
A network of peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams, working the same problems on different perimeters
Work that compounds. Customer security questions are a permanent obligation, so every assessment you make reusable and every check you automate keeps paying back, release after release
Modern tooling, actually adopted. Claude Code in every engineer’s hands, and a real say in how AI reshapes our build and delivery chain
A rare combination: security work with the leverage of owning the whole stack, down to our own Linux distribution
Mentorship from senior engineers with deep expertise across Linux, storage, packaging, and distributed systems — you will not be the only person who understands your perimeter
A long-term growth path toward becoming your team’s security reference and a senior voice in the network
Work that ships to production and runs at exabyte scale, in banking, healthcare, and government
Standard French benefits: meal vouchers, Navigo subsidy, mutuelle

title: Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) Fonds-Immobiliengesellschaft
description_clean:

Aufgaben

Sie übernehmen die laufende buchhalterische Betreuung mehrerer Gesellschaften aus dem Fonds- und Immobilienbereich, insbesondere in den Rechtsformen GmbH und GmbH & Co. KG.
Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexere Gesellschaftsstrukturen und mehrstufige Beteiligungsmodelle.
Die Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen gehört ebenso zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich wie die eigenständige bilanzielle Beurteilung der betreuten Gesellschaften.
Abschlüsse erstellen Sie nach den Vorgaben des HGB; Kenntnisse bzw. Erfahrungen im Bereich der Rechnungslegung nach KAGB sind dabei besonders willkommen.
Sie stellen die fristgerechte Aufbereitung verschiedener interner sowie externer Auswertungen und Reportings sicher.
Darüber hinaus erstellen Sie Ergebnisprognosen, Hochrechnungen und aussagekräftige Plan-Ist-Analysen.
Bei bilanziellen oder buchhalterischen Fragestellungen stehen Sie im Austausch mit Wirtschaftsprüfern, Geschäftspartnern sowie internen Ansprechpartnern.
Sie wirken aktiv bei der Klärung und Lösung komplexerer Sachverhalte mit und sorgen für eine verlässliche Zahlenbasis.

Qualifikation

Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) (m/w/d) oder eine Ausbildung zum Steuerfachangestellten (m/w/d).
Idealerweise bringen Sie bereits mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanz- und Rechnungsbuchhaltung mit.
Sie beherrschen die relevanten Bereiche der Buchhaltung – von Sachkonten über Debitoren und Kreditoren bis hin zur Anlagenbuchhaltung.
In der eigenständigen Erstellung und Betreuung von Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB sind Sie sicher.
Kenntnisse im Bereich KAGB bzw. der Rechnungslegung von Fonds- und Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften sind ein Plus.
Mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen arbeiten Sie routiniert. Erfahrungen mit SAP sind von Vorteil.
Eine gewissenhafte, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnet Sie aus.
Sie arbeiten gerne im Team, sind zuverlässig und behalten auch bei anspruchsvollen Themen den Überblick.
Neue Aufgabenstellungen gehen Sie pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert an.

Eine persönliche Ansprechperson, die Sie insbesondere während der ersten Monate begleitet.
Umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch interne sowie externe Weiterbildungsangebote.

title: Alternant·e Growth Marketing Manager | Thiga Academy
description_clean:
Alternance · Paris 9e · Télétravail · rythme d’alternance souhaité 3 semaines entreprise / 1 semaine école 
 
Thiga en 30 secondes : 
Thiga est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en IA et en digital. Nous accompagnons les plus grands groupes et scale-ups françaises : Decathlon, Doctolib, AXA, ManoMano, Mirakl, Disney, Leboncoin et une centaine d'autres. En inter-entreprise comme en intra, on transmet ce que nos consultants pratiquent chez nos clients tous les jours
 
Pourquoi ce poste : 

L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite.
C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir.
Ce que tu vas faire 🖇
1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing & Events


Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription


Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas


Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée


Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA


Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com


Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister


Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence


2. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer
Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires.


Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions


Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne


Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater


Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions


3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel
L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel.


Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA


Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable


L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous, c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique.
La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰
Le growth marketing moderne, c'est une combinaison d'intuition testée par la donnée, de vitesse d'exécution et de bons outils au bon moment.


LLM et agents : Claude (Pro et Code), Gemini


Génération visuelle et audio : Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, HeyGen


Marketing ops : HubSpot (CRM, marketing hub, workflows), Luma, Phantom Buster


Prise de notes et capitalisation : Granola, Notion AI


Vibe coding (en bonus, pour les profils qui veulent aller plus loin) : Lovable, Cursor pour bricoler des micro-outils internes


Tu n'as pas besoin de tout maîtriser à l'arrivée. On attend une vraie curiosité et l'envie de pratiquer, pas un CV exhaustif.
Le profil que nous recherchons 🌟


Formation : école de commerce ou de communication, en M1 ou M2, idéalement avec une spécialisation marketing, growth ou entrepreneuriat


Pratique IA personnelle prouvée : tu as un side project, un compte ChatGPT ou Claude que tu utilises tous les jours, un workflow Make ou n8n que tu as construit, un agent custom, un blog assisté par LLM, un repo GitHub, ou n'importe quoi qui démontre que l'IA est dans ta vie.


Réflexe growth : tu penses en funnel avant de penser en campagne, tu formules des hypothèses avant de produire, et tester puis mesurer te vient plus naturellement que produire pour produire


Appétence data : Excel ou Google Sheets n'ont pas de secret pour toi, et l'idée de creuser un dashboard pour comprendre pourquoi un taux de conversion a bougé t'intéresse plus qu'elle ne t'ennuie


Fibre communication : tu sais écrire pour être lu, tu as déjà animé une page, un compte ou une communauté


Rigueur opérationnelle et sens du détail : tu sais qu'une séquence email qui commence par « Bonjour {prénom} », ça fait tâche, et qu'un A/B test mal cadré ne prouve rien


Sensibilité business : tu comprends les concepts MQL, CAC, NPS, et tu sais qu'une belle campagne ne vaut rien si elle ne remplit pas les sessions


Au-delà des hard skills, on recherche surtout quelqu’un de curieux, volontaire, débrouillard et qui n’a pas peur de proposer des nouvelles idées !

About AQEMIA
 
AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.
 
For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn. 
 
About our Team
 
AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.
 
This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.
The role
AQEMIA's drug discovery programs and AI platform increasingly create value through licensing deals and strategic partnerships with pharma and biotech companies.

You'll make sure each licensing agreement maximises value creation for Aqemia, protects our IP, and the platform behind every program. Beyond licensing, you will become the trusted legal partner for CEO, founders, leadership and teams across the company, covering IP and patents, operational contracts, data and AI, compliance and corporate matters alongside specialist external counsel. In-house experience at a biotech, pharma or TechBio company, ideally a startup or lean legal team.
Exposure to AI, data or technology platform agreements (data rights, model training, ownership of outputs).
Experience building legal processes, templates or contract management from scratch.
Business development or commercial experience alongside your legal background.
Professional French.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.

Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

We are an engineering organization. Our mission is to “Ship great software” and build custom, large-scale software platforms on time, on budget, on target and on quality.

· You start in one of our engineering teams. Team size is maximum five people.

design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, operations and improving software based on user feedback and usage
data.

· Experience in C/C++, Python or Java
· Ability to learn fast 
 
Bonus skills or interests:
 
· Master or PhD in Computer Science or related fields like Mathematics or Physics

· Experience in Go, Kotlin, TypeScript or JavaScript

· Experience working with distributed systems in the Cloud

· Competitive Programming

German at C2 or native level, English at B2 level or higher.

title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
description_clean:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.
Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.
We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.
We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
In this role you own all of finance at Superchat end to end and report directly to the founders. When the board or our investors have a question about the numbers, you're the one who answers it.You'll take over our financial model and turn it into something the whole company can steer by. You'll own accounting through to the P&L, run forecasting and liquidity planning, and lead the annual audit.
Who We Want
7+ years of finance experience.You know the full cycle first-hand, from closing to forecast to board reporting.

Expert financial modelling.You build driver-based, integrated three-statement models from scratch and you document them so that others can operate them too.  
Forecasting.You've owned full budget and forecast cycles, you bring together top-down targets and bottom-up input from team leads, and you treat forecast accuracy as a measurable figure that has to improve.

title: Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description_clean: TL;DRJoin GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology.We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked.We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them.The problem we're solvingLarge organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting.GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow.Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems.What we're looking forYou can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here.You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions.You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached.You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them.You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere.You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence.You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents.You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to.What you'll doOver your first year:Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. This is what turns GlassDollar from software somebody logs into, into infrastructure their organisation operates on.APIs and MCP: public REST APIs and MCP servers for our customers, their engineers, and increasingly their AI agents. The interesting part isn't exposing endpoints, it's designing an external platform we'll still be happy supporting years from now.AI inside real workflows: embeddings, vector search, and LLMs across a large database of startups and corporate innovation data. We're less interested in adding a ✨ button to everything than in finding places where AI removes real work.Workflow automation: triggers, notifications, and automation that replace humans moving information between systems.Core product engineering: React interfaces, APIs, PostgreSQL queries, permissions, migrations, performance work, and the occasional bug whose root cause makes everybody stare silently at their screen.Our stackFrontend: TypeScript, React, Material UI, Apollo Client, PlaywrightBackend: Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, JestInfrastructure: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, SentryIncreasingly: LLM APIs, embeddings, vector search, MCP, AI-assisted engineering workflowsYou don't need experience with every item. Reasoning about systems matters more to us than having memorised our exact stack.RequirementsSubstantial production experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.jsComfortable reasoning about relational databases, not just the ORMCan independently take a feature from unclear starting point to productionCan read unfamiliar code without immediately proposing a rewriteNice to have:Experience with GraphQL, Prisma, or PostgreSQL at scaleExposure to LLM APIs, embeddings, or vector searchExperience owning systems, not just featuresDon't check every box? Apply anyway. We'd rather have the conversation than lose someone over a bullet point.How we hireHow we workWe're a small engineering team, so there are fewer places for responsibility to disappear and no chain of five people between you and a decision. We prefer written context over meetings the calendar invented, and working software over elaborate process.Quickly doesn't mean carelessly. Sometimes the fastest route is the simple version today, sometimes it's another day on a foundation twenty future features will sit on. Knowing which situation you're in is part of the job. Expect to ship to production very early.How we hireNo seven-stage endurance test. No algorithm trivia disconnected from the work.Intro. You, us, and whether this is the environment you're actually looking for.Technical conversation. We go deep on something difficult you've built: the decisions, the alternatives, what you'd do differently now.Technical assessment. Usually live coding on a realistic problem, sometimes a small proof of concept instead. We care how you think, not whether your solution matches ours.Offer. If there's strong mutual conviction, we move.One last thingJob descriptions have a habit of producing candidates who optimise themselves against bullet points. Please don't. If you're reading this thinking "I can do most of this, but I haven't worked with MCP", apply.Strong fundamentals, meaningful software shipped, and a bias toward ownership are what we're looking for. Professional expertise. You have worked 5+ years as a Game Designer and have successfully shipped or taken at least one game through early development (concept, prototype, soft launch or validation).
Squad RPG love. You know your way around the hero collection / squad RPG genre, play these games yourself, and can deconstruct what makes the market leaders successful. 
Generalist mindset. You are comfortable switching between systems, combat, economy, content and UX - and you care about the game as a whole.
Balancing fundamentals. You have hands-on experience with spreadsheets and balancing models for combat, progression, and economy.
AI-first. You already use AI tools in your daily design work and are curious to push what is possible with them.

English as company language. You are open-minded, confident working in a multicultural environment and eager to use your English skills every day.

Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Primavera P6, MS Project, TILOS und Excel

Analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikations- und Teamstärke
Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)
Bereitschaft zu projektbezogenen Dienstreisen

Benefits

Mitarbeit an anspruchsvollen und zukunftsweisenden Infrastruktur-, Industrie- und Energieprojekten
Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum
Aktive Mitgestaltung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Digitalisierung unserer Prozesse im Projektmanagement und in der Terminplanung
Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären und erfahrenen Team
Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und moderne Arbeitsausstattung
Umfassende Einarbeitung an unseren Standorten Hamburg oder Römerberg

Attraktive Mitarbeiterangebote und Vergünstigungen über ein Corporate-Benefits-Programm

title: Senior Account Executive - Automotive
description_clean:
Job Title: Senior Account Executive 
Type: Full-time
Experience: 5+ years
 
What about us?
 
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
 
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
 
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
 
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀  
 
The Role
 
As a Senior Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own revenue generation, focusing on winning high-value, strategic new-business opportunities. You will engage with senior stakeholders, navigate complex sales cycles, and create tailored value propositions that showcase how INFINIT’s AI-driven fintech platform transforms business operations.
 
We are looking for a high-performing hunter with a strong track record of closing larger deals, managing multi-stakeholder relationships, and driving high-impact commercial outcomes.What do we want to achieve together?
You will own the full sales cycle, from strategic prospecting to negotiation and closing, with a primary focus on acquiring large, high-value customers particularly automotive clients such as car dealerships
You will act as a catalyst for innovation in large-account acquisition, identifying new growth opportunities and emerging verticals, particularly within the dealership ecosystem.
You will design and execute outbound strategies tailored to key account leads, with an emphasis on automotive dealership prospects.
You will build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers within key account prospects understanding their unique operational needs and aligning them with INFINIT’s solutions.
You will collaborate closely with Product, and Customer Success teams to deliver seamless and impactful customer journeys for dealership clients.
You will drive commercial strategy and contribute to refining our value proposition for the automotive segment and other large verticals.
What do you need to be successful in this role?
5+ years of B2B sales experience, including proven success selling into mid-market or enterprise accounts.
Demonstrated ability to run and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with deal sizes significantly above SMB level.
Strong communication, negotiation, and executive-level presentation skills.A hunter mentality: proactive, resourceful, and relentless in pursuing large opportunities.
Experience thriving in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments with evolving processes.
Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail; comfortable using CRM and sales intelligence tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
Ability to work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Operations to ensure a seamless customer handover and long-term success.
What will you find working at INFINIT?
Competitive Salary and Equity: We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.
Diverse and Inclusive Team: Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.
Inspiring Mission: We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.
Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance.
Quality Time Together: We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.
Personal Time Off: Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.
Flexibility and Ownership: We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of remote working with occasional central venue gatherings.
Diversity and Inclusion
 
INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Influencer Manager fayn. (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Deine Aufgaben
Dein Bereich als Influencer Manager fayn. (m/w/d):  

Du unterstützt unser Management bei allen anfallenden Aufgaben rund um Influencer Relations, Kooperationen und Social Media.
Du betreust unsere bestehenden Influencer innen und Partner innen, koordinierst Abstimmungen und sorgst für eine professionelle und wertschätzende Kommunikation.
Du identifizierst neue Influencer innen und Marketingpartner innen, recherchierst passende Profile und unterstützt bei der Gewinnung neuer Kooperationen.
Du entwickelst kreative Ansätze und Konzepte, um unseren Social-Media-Auftritt kontinuierlich zu optimieren und weiter auszubauen.
Du bist im direkten Austausch mit unserer Community und übernimmst das Community Management mit viel Gespür für Trends, Zielgruppen und Markenkommunikation.

Dein Profil
Deine Stärken die wir in unserem Team brauchen:   

Du bringst erste Erfahrung im Influencer Marketing, Creator Relations oder Social Media Management mit.
Du hast ein sicheres Gespür für relevante Creator, Plattformtrends und zielgruppennahe Kooperationen.
Du verstehst, wie erfolgreiche Influencer-Kampagnen auf Instagram und TikTok funktionieren – von der Ansprache bis zur Auswertung.
Du überzeugst durch eine starke Kommunikation, ein gutes Beziehungsmanagement und ein sicheres Auftreten im Austausch mit Influencern und Partnern.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst Deadlines, Abstimmungen und Kampagnenziele jederzeit im Blick.
Du kombinierst Kreativität, Zahlenverständnis und organisatorisches Talent.
Du arbeitest gerne bereichsübergreifend und stimmst dich eng mit Brand, Content, Design und Social Media ab.

Warum wir?
FAYN Supplements steht für höchste Qualität und innovative Produkte im Bereich Nahrungsergänzungsmittel. Wir setzen auf wissenschaftlich fundierte Rezepturen, um die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden unserer Kunden zu fördern. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen engagierten und kreativen Social Media Manager (m/w/d), der unsere Markenpräsenz in den sozialen Medien weiter ausbaut und stärkt.
Deine Perspektiven:  

Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem jungen Team
Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben, die viel Eigeninitiative erfordern
Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche und transparente Kommunikation
Zukunftsorientierte Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen

Unsere Benefits:  

Flexibilität durch digitale BenefitsOb Shopping, Tanken oder Freizeitaktivitäten – du erhältst ein monatliches Guthaben, das du ganz nach deinen Wünschen einsetzen kannst. Alternativ kannst du mit Wellpass deutschlandweit auf über 8.000 Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote zugreifen – online oder vor Ort – und profitierst dabei von unserem attraktiven Firmenrabatt.

Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager
At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.
As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .
What you'll be doing
In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.
Day-to-day in this role you'll:

Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. 

What we offer
This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.
You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.
You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.
Next steps
If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.
After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.
Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und den Fachbereichen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen strukturiert erfasst, Aufgaben sauber verteilt und Statusdaten ohne manuelles Nachfassen ins Reporting fließen.Das erwartet Dich:Workflows konfigurieren: Du entwickelst Workflows in unserer GRC-Software OneTrust, von der Analyse des Ablaufs bis zur fertigen Konfiguration mit Datenfeldern, Statuslogiken, Verantwortlichkeiten, Eskalationen und automatischen Benachrichtigungen.Systeme integrieren: Du verbindest OneTrust über Schnittstellen und moderne Workflow-Tools mit weiteren Systemen bei auxmoney, zum Beispiel Slack, SharePoint oder Outlook, damit Fachbereiche Statusupdates dort liefern können, wo sie ohnehin arbeiten.Automatisierungen aufbauen: Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Handgriffe und ersetzt sie durch Automatisierungen, die Informationen anfordern, Aufgaben verteilen, Fristen überwachen und Folgeaktivitäten auslösen, etwa bei regelmäßigen Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche oder bei der Überprüfung unserer Dienstleister.KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du baust mit unseren KI-Bausteinen konkrete Lösungen für das Risikomanagement, zum Beispiel zur Strukturierung von Informationen, zur Vorbereitung von Bewertungen, zum Erkennen fehlender Angaben oder zum Zusammenfassen von Berichten, und achtest dabei auf Nachvollziehbarkeit und Qualität.Qualität absichern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, prüfst Workflow-Logiken und KI-Lösungen vor dem Einsatz und dokumentierst Konfigurationen, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten so, dass andere darauf aufbauen können.Reporting verbessern: Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen vollständig und strukturiert erfasst werden, und überführst Statusdaten automatisiert in klare Übersichten für Management und Board.Flexibel arbeiten: Du arbeitest flexibel aus dem Homeoffice. Wenn Du in der Nähe von Düsseldorf studierst, triffst Du Dein Team einmal pro Woche im Büro, ansonsten sehen wir uns regelmäßig digital und zu gemeinsamen Team-Tagen vor Ort.Das bringst Du mit:Immatrikulation und Praxis: Du bist in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Business Analytics, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert und hast bereits praktisch mit Software, Automatisierungen oder Daten gearbeitet, zum Beispiel im Studium, im Nebenjob oder in eigenen Projekten.Technisches Verständnis: Du hast Freude daran, neue Software zu verstehen, Workflows zu konfigurieren und technische Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen. Plus: Erfahrung mit Workflow-, Low-Code/No-Code-, Ticket- oder GRC-Systemen.Automatisierung und KI-Mindset: Du möchtest herausfinden, wie KI-Anwendungen und automatisierte Workflows das Risikomanagement verbessern, und hinterfragst Ergebnisse kritisch, statt Dich blind auf Vorschläge zu verlassen.Daten und Schnittstellen: Du denkst in Datenstrukturen und verstehst, wie Systeme über Schnittstellen miteinander sprechen. title: Chief of Staff
description_clean:

TL;DR: Consulting teached you to be right. Now you are the one who makes it happen. Own the operating rhythm of the company, from leadership meetings and priority setting to follow-through on every decision, so the founders spend their time on the calls only they can make.
Lead the most important strategic projects across product, commercial and finance, from first hypothesis to implemented decision, with the full mandate of the founders behind you.
Take our GPU and AI inference products to market with the founders and the product, sales and partner leads. Define target segments, go-to-market strategy and the partner motion until the revenue is there and beyond.

Turn the founders' strategy into priorities, owners and deadlines for the leadership team, and hold the company to them.

Two to five years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or a comparable firm, an outstanding academic record and a verifiable history of early promotion and top reviews.
You are the bar-raiser that partners put on the unstructured problem. You have owned one end to end, taken it past the recommendation into implementation, and can show the result. You can explain how you structured it and what you personally contributed.
You think in numbers. You have built financial models and commercial analyses, for example on go-to-market, pricing or sales performance, that changed a client's results, and they hold up when an investor pushes on them.
You get up to speed on technical domains in weeks. You can explain how GPU compute or cloud infrastructure creates value for a customer, or show how you did the same in a comparable field.
AI-native working style: you use AI tools such as Claude to move faster and work smarter. This is a baseline expectation at Impossible Cloud, not a differentiator.
Professional proficiency in English and German.

Competitive salary coupled with direct engagement in your success through an enticing ESOP.
Ideal company stage with established initial revenue and a distinctive edge in the cloud industry leading to fast growth opportunities.
Collaboration with experienced, passionate, and supportive colleagues, leveraging cutting-edge technology in the cloud industry.
Fantastic office situated in a trendy location with access to complimentary healthy brain food and a subsidized premium gym membership.
Monthly collaborative meet-up weeks featuring team events.

title: Chief of Staff (m/w/x)
description_clean: About DoctorflixMedizin entwickelt sich schneller als je zuvor, und Ärzte müssen ihr ganzes Berufsleben lang mithalten. Doctorflix ist die digitale Plattform, auf der Ärzte im deutschsprachigen Raum lernen: kostenlos, zertifiziert und mit dem größten Angebot im Markt. Weil wir dort sind, wo Ärzte ihr Wissen auf den neuesten Stand bringen, sind wir auch der Kanal, über den Pharma- und MedTech-Unternehmen sie relevant erreichen. Unsere Vision: die führende Plattform für medizinisches Wissen zu werden, zuerst in DACH, dann international. Ein Ort, an dem Ärzte lernen, sich austauschen und bessere Entscheidungen für ihre Patienten treffen. Wir sind ein VC-finanziertes Startup aus Berlin und wachsen organisch wie anorganisch.RoleWir sind aus der frühen Startup-Phase herausgewachsen: ein neues Sales-Team, neue Produkte, anorganisches Wachstum in Vorbereitung, der Schritt ins Ausland in Sicht. Was uns jetzt bremst, sind nicht fehlende Ideen, sondern Prozesse, die nicht mitwachsen.Als Chief of Staff arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Gründern Hans und Leo und machst aus Strategie ein laufendes System. Du baust unsere Operations so um, dass sie bei doppelter Größe noch funktionieren, automatisierst, was kein Mensch mehr tun sollte, und übernimmst die Projekte, die über unser nächstes Jahr entscheiden.Das ist weder eine Assistenzrolle noch ein reiner Strategie-Job. Du schreibst nicht die Folie über den Prozess. Du baust den Prozess und, wo es Sinn ergibt, den Agenten, der ihn ausführt.Your tasksOperations & Organisation für ScaleDu nimmst unsere Kernprozesse auseinander (Angebot bis Rechnung, Kampagnen-Go-live, Content-Produktion, Reporting) und baust sie neu: klare Ownership, saubere Übergaben, messbare Durchlaufzeiten.Du etablierst unseren Operating Rhythm: OKR-Prozess mit Owner pro Key Result, Leadership-Meetings, KPI-Reviews, nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen.Du professionalisierst die Organisation: Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, ein Tool-Stack, der zusammenspielt (ClickUp, Notion, Metabase, CRM), und genau die Regeln, die wir brauchen. Nicht mehr.Gemeinsam mit Finance und externen Partnern machst du Backoffice-Prozesse wie Rechnungsstellung, Forderungsmanagement und Abschluss-Zulieferung robust.Automatisierung & AI-WorkflowsDu verantwortest unsere AI-native-Agenda: In jedem Team identifizierst du die Workflows mit dem größten Hebel, automatisierst sie und misst die Wirkung (Zeit, Fehlerquote, Durchlaufzeit).Du baust selbst: Agenten und Automationen mit LLM-APIs (z. B. Claude), n8n, Make oder Zapier, Skripten und Schnittstellen zwischen unseren Systemen. Bei größeren Vorhaben steuerst du Product und Engineering.Du sorgst dafür, dass jede Automation dokumentiert ist, überwacht wird und einen Owner hat, statt nach drei Monaten still kaputtzugehen.Strategische SonderprojekteM&A & Post-Merger-Integration: Du begleitest Zukäufe von der Due Diligence bis zur Integration. Teams, Kunden, Plattformen, Inhalte und Prozesse führst du mit einem 100-Tage-Plan und klaren Synergiezielen zusammen.Internationalisierung: Du bereitest den Markteintritt außerhalb von DACH vor: Business Case, Markt- und Partneranalyse, operatives Playbook.Themen, die heute niemand im Team ownt, die aber jemand ownen muss.FührungDu führst Teams und Projektgruppen bereichsübergreifend, je nach Phase auch interimistisch, etwa ein integriertes Team nach einem Zukauf.Du forderst Teamleads heraus, ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen, und hältst nach, dass sie erreicht werden.Fundraising & Investor RelationsDu unterstützt die Gründer bei Finanzierungsrunden: Equity Story, Finanzmodell, Datenraum, Due-Diligence-Fragen.Du verantwortest Board-Unterlagen und das monatliche Investoren-Reporting inhaltlich mit.Your profileOperator: Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mehrere Jahre in operativer Verantwortung, z. B. in Operations, BizOps oder Founder's Office eines Scale-ups, als Gründer oder nach einem Start in Beratung, PE oder VC mit Wechsel ins Operative. Du hast Operations nachweislich auf- oder umgebaut, nicht nur analysiert.Automator: Du kannst konkrete Prozesse zeigen, die du automatisiert hast, mit Vorher und Nachher. Du arbeitest sicher mit Low-Code-Tools und APIs. SQL oder Python sind ein Plus.AI-native: Du nutzt AI nicht als besseres Google. Du hast Workflows gebaut, in denen LLMs echte Arbeit übernehmen (Agenten, Integrationen, Kontext- und Prompt-Design, Qualitätskontrolle), und weißt, wo sie scheitern.Analytisch & strukturiert: Du zerlegst unklare Probleme schnell, rechnest Business Cases selbst und entscheidest auf Basis von Daten, auch wenn sie unvollständig sind.Führung: Du hast Teams oder bereichsübergreifende Projekte geführt und bringst Menschen dazu mitzuziehen, auch ohne disziplinarische Linie.Doctorflix-DNA: Drive (du willst das Ergebnis und gehst dafür die Extrameile), Hands-on (Pragmatismus vor Perfektion), Proaktivität (du wartest nicht auf Aufträge) und eine Neugier, von der das Team etwas lernen kann.Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch fließend.Why us?Hebel: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Einblick in Board, Investoren und M&A. Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen, nicht in Quartalen.Impact: Unsere Fortbildungen erreichen Zehntausende Ärzte in DACH und damit die Versorgung ihrer Patienten.Entwicklung: Die Rolle ist ein Sprungbrett. Je nachdem, wie du und das Unternehmen sich entwickeln, kann daraus eine Leitungsrolle werden, etwa in Operations oder für einen neuen Markt.Spielraum für AI: Freiheit, neue Tools zu testen und einzuführen.Benefits: Attraktives Gehaltspaket inkl. Aktienpaket (VSOP) sowie Urban Sports Club.Team & Ort: Office in der Kulturbrauerei (Prenzlauer Berg), regelmäßige Team-Events.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

eignungsdiagnostischen und kompetenzorientierten Auswahlverfahren.Du kannst Gespräche strukturieren, genau zuhören, kritisch nachfragen und deine Einschätzung anschließend nachvollziehbar begründen.Du title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
description_clean:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.
Why this role
You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission
Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.
What you will do

Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.
Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.
Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with
Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 
What you bring
Must have

Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
Clear, structured documentation habits
Fluent English and German skills
Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
Customer satisfaction with your contribution
Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

 
What We Offer
Culture & Growth

A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.
